note: RIDDLER SEAT 5 — the footnoted satirist. Riddle: fantasy is a funhouse mirror angled exactly at us. The footnote carries the dagger. Equivalents ride this shelf (Tom Holt, Christopher Moore, K.J. Parker).
interactions: The Colour of Magic (1983) opens as parody of the tolkien shelf's archetypes — the mirror aimed at the elegist
Good Omens (1990) co-written with Neil Gaiman; the only novel on the roster with two riddlers holding the pen
friendship and mutual admiration with Douglas Adams (edge: adams shelf)
K.J. Parker IS Tom Holt: one human occupying two seats on this shelf — house precedent for a mask hiding a person
Alzheimer's advocacy: the 2008-09 documentaries (Emmy) — the satirist's last public act was against the disease
